title: CIS Critical Security Controls v8 — Cernus runtime crosswalk
description: CIS v8 Safeguards Cernus can evaluate from runtime facts. Mappings are approximate where a Safeguard is broader than the observable fact; the statement text says what is actually checked.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Software Inventory
controls.statement: Maintain an inventory of deployed software components. Checked: every deployed container image has a stored SBOM.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process
controls.statement: Maintain secure configurations. Checked: no open misconfiguration findings from configuration scans.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Vulnerability Management Process
controls.statement: Continuously assess and track vulnerabilities. Checked: the most recent scan is within the configured freshness window.

controls.title: Perform Automated Operating System Patch Management
controls.statement: Automate remediation verification. Checked: automated rescans exist for this system's assets.

controls.title: Remediate Detected Vulnerabilities
controls.statement: Remediate vulnerabilities on a risk-based schedule. Checked: no open finding is past its remediation window.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Application Development Process
controls.statement: Apply a secure development process. Checked: the latest deployment passed its automated test gate.

controls.title: Leverage Vetted Modules or Services
controls.statement: Use vetted third-party components. Checked: the latest deployment passed the dependency scan gate.

controls.title: Implement Code-Level Security Checks
controls.statement: Apply static analysis. Checked: the latest deployment passed the SAST gate.
